note: Dawes County (NE) zoning: county assessor issues zoning permits; the 2012 county zoning resolution adopts an Official Zoning Map only as a document. The county GIS viewer (dawes.gworks.com, Geo Workshop) exposes no ArcGIS REST services and no zoning layer; the assessor viewer and smartsiteplan viewer show parcels only. NE state GIS (gis.ne.gov Enterprise) has no zoning layer. ArcGIS search for Dawes/Chadron zoning returned no service. Chadron and Crawford zoning is published only as regulation PDFs, with no queryable district layer found.
